correctness.rationale: The positive pressure root exists uniquely for every finite penalty. Inducing an ergodic measure at markers yields a finite-mean gap marginal r, whose entropy is finite by comparison to q_j=exp(-t-pa_j); the two-sided gap code generates the induced system. Kac and Abramov reduce the pressure inequality to nonnegativity of relative entropy; equality fixes the marginal and the iid gap process. The all-zero measure has strictly smaller variational pressure. At t_n=log(n-1+s), eventual doubling bounds the normalized sum of smaller gaps by a vanishing multiple of a_{n-1}/a_n (plus a finite prefix), and the larger-gap exponential tail, even with its length factor, tends uniformly to zero on positive pressure compacts. Monotonicity brackets a_n p_n and length bias gives condensation and the mean. For the microscopic law, geometrically stopping at the next distinguished gap gives the displayed transform: after division by q_n only the j=n−1 term survives, giving s/(s+1−exp(-u)). The blocks of intervening gaps are independent. Their mean normalized at the *macroscopic* scale is (1−pi_n)/pi_n, so neighboring starts are asymptotically unit spaced. Under stationarity, conditioning on the distinguished gap containing zero (probability tending to one) gives a uniform integer offset independent of both sides; minimum rescaled separation 1 reduces vague convergence on compacts to finitely many starts and gives joint phase independence. For factorials, the lower-length normalized sum is 1/n+O(n^-2); the quadratic Taylor remainder is O(n^-2) and the upper tail is exponentially small on compact s-ranges, giving the stated signs and coefficients. A separate bisection sweep for s=.3,.5,.7 and n=40,80,160,320 checked the factorial formulas and exact-delay transform against their limits, not the spatial convergence. No uploaded code was executed.
residual_risks: The finite numerical check is only for factorial gaps and specified interior s. The exact argument, not the numerical sweep, proves the general limits. Neither endpoint boundary layer nor arbitrary microscopic first-moment convergence is claimed.

value.rationale: The result answers what a stationary observation sees as markers become expensive: gaps with vanishing marker-conditioned probability occupy nearly all time. It identifies both the distance scale of a stationary near-lattice and a smaller nondegenerate correction tied to the second-largest relevant length, rather than merely computing an entropy root or confirming concentration numerically.
